payload.description_html: Fig. 15 - Interpretative reconstruction of  Peripeltopleurus jurassicus sp. n. from the Sinemurian Osteno Lagerstätte, Como Province, Northwe-stern Italy. Reconstruction based on the holotype, MSNM V659; skeletal elements in dashed lines inferred from P. vexillipinnis and P. hypsisomus (Bürgin1992). (A) Skull skeleton in left lateral view. (B) Skull skeleton in dorsal view. (C) Full body reconstruction in left lateral view. Scale bars 10 mm
